dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日本医師会標準レセプトソフト); uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL with ORCDBMAIN runtime and MCP framework typical of ORCA system

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (shinryo-koui) input system - confirmation screen 2 (KID2) for medical treatment act entry
purpose.summary: This program is a screen-navigation subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software. It handles button-click events on a confirmation screen (KID2), sets flags for printing prescriptions/medication information, and transitions to the appropriate next window via the ORCDBMAIN MCP framework.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (32 copybooks) for screen layout and shared areas
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
MCP event-driven screen navigation pattern (EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT)
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
No FILE SECTION, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
Only 1 PIC clause in WORKING-STORAGE (rest in copybooks)
verdict.notes: Japanese text in comments is garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. The 'grpsys' tokens appearing inline before CALL appear to be label-like artifacts or group system markers specific to the ORCA build system.
